name: Neighborhood Missions
quality: Playable authored neighborhood; simplified art, physical device and human playtest approval remain open.
changes: Player-centered perspective portal with per-eye aperture masking; depth continues beyond display sides and rear.
Foreground frame faces automatically transparent; head-following panels removed.
First-person AR alongside first-person VR and player-follow diorama VR/AR.
Gold world target, persistent minimap, large mission map and native XR mission selection.
Eight three-stage resident stories and six additional named residents, with an independent validated credit ledger.
Three formerly solid building blocks now have doors and furnished interiors; existing print shop, loft and workshop remain connected.
Hold-to-run release actively brakes; legacy files, save key, chapter layout and original reward are preserved.
acceptance: Local model acceptance passed; actual browser and public acceptance pending.
